blocks.text: The Range Runner is a newer model sleeper house with standard and upgraded features--including the most overall sleeping area--all at an affordable price.

Weekdays: $450 · 2 Night Weekends: $795

Taxes and fees apply

Our 2024 17' x 8' Ice Castle Range Runner is one of the newest houses in our fleet, and the most reasonably priced Ice Castle rental we offer. It features upgraded sleeping options giving it the most sleeping room of all our 17' houses, black interior package, and a significantly larger, more comfortable bathroom than older Ice Castle models.  The house is fully prepped before you arrive — warm, powered, and with 6 fishing holes drilled for you.  If you want a newer 17’ sleeper with modern comfort at reasonable price, the Range Runner is an excellent choice for groups of 4–6.

Turn key ready
